_comment: Template for one gateway. Copy to sites/<gatewayName>.json and fill in.
hwid: inherit the 24-hex-char HWID of the RESI unit this Pi replaces, so the child
device names stay identical in ThingsBoard and existing dashboards keep binding.
Read it off the ECO_<HWID>_gw device of the unit being replaced.
unitId: MUST be verified per site with scan-modbus.py. Only unitId 88 is known from
the one recovered config, and only for a single meter -- how PF2..PF4 are addressed
was never recorded anywhere. Do not assume 88/89/90/91 or 1/2/3/4.
tempSensors: PT1000 RTDs on the C4's onboard AIOX channels, reached over the board's
INTERNAL serial link (internalSerial below) at unitId 1 -- not on the meter bus.
'channel' is the 1-based AIOX channel. Which channels the site's sensors occupy was
never recorded; verify with 'scan-modbus.py --aiox' before trusting 1 and 2.
internalSerial: on the original card this was /dev/ttyACM1, but the Cinterion LTE
modem also enumerates as ttyACM*, so the numbering is not stable across a rebuild.
Pin it with a udev rule by USB path.
description: Raspberry Pi replacement for RESI unit at <site>
